title: Realizability of a full correlation hierarchy
statement: Characterize the symmetric locally finite factorial moment measures of probability laws on locally finite configurations, distinguishing existence from uniqueness.
status: As of 9 November 2026: Lenard's symmetry, positivity and normalization characterization supplies existence; determinacy requires additional conditions.

title: Helgason spherical support problem on a smooth Hadamard manifold
statement: For complete simply connected negatively curved smooth \(M\), do zero integrals of \(f\in C_c^\infty(M)\) over all geodesic spheres enclosing a closed ball \(B\) imply \(\operatorname{supp}f\subset B\)?
status: As of 9 November 2026: verified for real-analytic metrics; a general smooth-metric resolution was not found. The precise source is Quinto's Problem 4.1, not a ray-transform support theorem.

title: Entire convex Monge--Ampere rigidity
statement: Must every convex entire solution of \(\det D^2u=1\) be quadratic?
status: As of 9 November 2026: yes in all dimensions, by the J\"orgens--Calabi--Pogorelov theorem; convex viscosity solutions are included.

title: Entire minimal-graph Bernstein problem
statement: For which \(n\) is every smooth entire minimal graph over \(\mathbb R^n\) an affine hyperplane?
status: As of 9 November 2026: exactly \(n\le7\); nonaffine entire minimal graphs exist for \(n\ge8\).

title: Metric rigidity of a Sobolev composition isometry
statement: If a smooth diffeomorphism of closed Riemannian manifolds induces an isometry of their full \(H^1\) inner products by pullback, must it preserve their metrics?
status: As of 9 November 2026: yes, by volume and Dirichlet-form recovery; the composition condition is essential.

title: Infinite volume of a complete noncompact positive-Ricci three-manifold
statement: Does a complete connected noncompact Riemannian three-manifold with positive Ricci curvature have infinite volume?
status: As of 9 November 2026: yes; Yau's theorem covers nonnegative Ricci curvature in every dimension.

title: Diffeomorphism type of equal-period closed-geodesic manifolds
statement: Must a closed simply connected Riemannian manifold whose prime unit-speed geodesics all have the same period be diffeomorphic to a compact rank-one symmetric space?
status: As of 9 November 2026: cohomology is constrained to the rank-one symmetric models; the unrestricted smooth classification was not found resolved. The result of \citet[definition on p.~1 and Main Theorem on p.~3]{lisong2026zoll} assumes simple closed prime geodesics of a common period, as well as an entire Grauert tube, and proves metric rigidity only for the complex-projective cohomology type. Those additional hypotheses do not remove the gap for the notebook's question.

title: Existence of contact structures in dimension three
statement: Which closed smooth three-manifolds admit a contact plane field?
status: As of 9 November 2026: exactly the orientable ones: necessity follows from the contact volume orientation and sufficiency from Martinet's theorem.
